objective: Couple each newly emitted static visual observation with its own evidence; preserve saved legacy reports and strict publication checks.
acceptance_criteria: New gate-v2 requests use explicit versioned observation/evidence items with nonempty video references, never parallel indexes.
Normalization preserves exact text and order, rejects malformed, mixed, parallel or foreign evidence and never invents timestamps or sources.
Legacy saved strings/indexes remain unchanged, including incomplete five-observation one-reference candidates; no silent pruning, approval or receipt transplantation.
Static-only instructions do not replace independent pixel validation; interval alone cannot approve any observation.
All product tests/builds exclusively GitHub Actions, independent exact-head review before integration; no provider/runtime action.
